title: StudyContract v1
description: omicstat StudyContract v1. Field names are identical to medstat StudyContract v1 (medstat-55692f7); only their meaning is mapped to omics experiments (IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC section 4). A declaration that disagrees with the executed run parameters is a publication blocker.

study_design.description: omicstat meaning: the experimental design - two-group, multi-group, paired, time-course, and the batch structure (e.g. 'two-group, 3 vs 3 biological replicates, one sequencing batch').

analysis_population.description: omicstat meaning: the sample set - path of the sample sheet, samples (or cells) included and excluded, and the biological-replicate unit. Single-cell analyses must name the column that identifies the biological sample.

estimand.description: omicstat meaning: the contrast and effect size - design formula, contrast (e.g. 'condition: treated vs control'), and the effect-size measure (log2 fold change, with or without shrinkage).

exposure_or_intervention.description: omicstat meaning: the condition variable being compared (e.g. the sample-sheet column 'condition') and its non-reference level.

comparator.description: omicstat meaning: the reference level of the condition variable (e.g. 'control').

outcomes.description: omicstat meaning: the feature space - genes, cell-type proportions or co-expression modules - with species and annotation version (e.g. 'Homo sapiens genes, GENCODE_v44'). timepoint/time_horizon records the sampling time point (e.g. 'single post-treatment sampling at 24 h').

covariates.description: omicstat meaning: additional design-formula terms such as batch, sex or donor, in the order they enter the design.

missing_data.description: omicstat meaning: the filtering strategy - low-count filtering, QC thresholds, and the samples or cells removed with the reason for each.

multiplicity.description: omicstat meaning: multiple-testing control - method (e.g. Benjamini-Hochberg) and the adjusted-p threshold; for enrichment analyses the correction applied across gene sets.

analysis_sets.description: omicstat meaning: the named analysis sets (e.g. 'all samples passing QC', 'sensitivity: outlier sample removed').

semantic_declarations.description: Machine-checkable declarations required before a contract can support ready status. Legacy descriptive fields remain accepted but are not sufficient by themselves. Field names are unchanged from medstat StudyContract v1; the omics meaning of each is given in its description (IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC section 4).

study_design.description: design_type: the experimental design type (two-group, multi-group, paired, time-course, with batch structure).

population.description: definition: the sample set and the biological-replicate unit (single-cell: the sample column).

estimand.description: measure: effect-size measure (e.g. 'log2 fold change, apeglm-shrunken'); target: the contrast (e.g. 'condition: treated vs control').

exposure.description: variable_or_intervention: the condition variable and its compared level.

comparator.description: definition: the reference level of the condition variable.

outcomes.description: identity: the feature space with species and annotation version (e.g. 'genes, Homo sapiens, GENCODE_v44'); timing: the sampling time point.

missing_data.description: strategy: low-count / QC filtering and removed samples or cells with reasons.

multiplicity.description: strategy: multiple-testing method and threshold (e.g. 'BH, padj < 0.05').
